newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan looks to European PHS phone standard - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan looks to European PHS phone standard - paper.

text.p: Japan will explore adapting the European unified standard to its own specifications for the new Personal Handyphone System (PHS), Nihon Keizai Shimbun financial daily said on Sunday.

It said Japan's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications and major equipment manufacturers such as NEC Corp will study the development of a composite mobile phone which is compatible with the PHS system and Europe's Global System for Mobile communications (GSM) standard.
The paper quoted a ministry official as saying Japanese manufacturers of PHS phones would benefit from a quick adaptation of GSM, as it would broaden the use of their product.
The GSM system is used in more than 80 countries in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and is fast becoming the world standard, the paper reported.
In contrast, the low-power PHS system is only in use in a few more than 10 countries in Asia and Latin America.
